fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that offer a balance between the speed of hover transport and the protection of tracked vehicles, well-suited to operations on developed road networks. Armed with assault rifles and Grand Mauler infantry gauss cannons, these platoons field some of the hardest-hitting crew-served weapons available to conventional infantry, capable of threatening armored vehicles at extended range.
